Web search results for query: "arXiv speculative decoding LLM inference"

Links: [{"title":"[2511.11733] Speculative Decoding in Decentralized LLM Inference: Turning Communication Latency into Computation Throughput","url":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.11733"},{"title":"Speculative Decoding in Decentralized LLM Inference:Turning Communication Latency into Computation Throughput","url":"https://arxiv.org/html/2511.11733"},{"title":"[2608.24004] AgentSpec: Speculative Decoding for Batch Inference of LLM Agents","url":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.24004"},{"title":"[2503.00491] Tutorial Proposal: Speculative Decoding for Efficient LLM Inference","url":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.00491"},{"title":"A Survey on Efficient Inference for Large Language Models","url":"https://arxiv.org/pdf/2404.14294"},{"title":"AgentSpec: Speculative Decoding for Batch Inference of LLM Agents","url":"https://arxiv.org/html/2608.24004"},{"title":"Speculative Decoding and Beyond: An In-Depth Survey of Techniques","url":"https://arxiv.org/pdf/2502.19732"},{"title":"[2510.13161] Mirror Speculative Decoding: Breaking the Serial Barrier in LLM Inference","url":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.13161"},{"title":"Accelerating LLM Inference with Staged Speculative Decoding","url":"https://arxiv.org/pdf/2308.04623"}]

The search turned up several recent arXiv papers on speculative decoding:

- **Decentralized Speculative Decoding (arXiv:2511.11733, Nov 2025):** This paper applies speculative decoding to distributed inference across nodes. It reports up to 2.56x speedup on HumanEval and 2.59x on GSM8K, and it also adds an adaptive verification step that needs no retraining.
- **Mirror Speculative Decoding (arXiv:2510.13161, Oct 2025):** This work targets the cost of autoregressive draft generation, which limits gains as draft size grows. It reports 2.8x to 5.8x wall-time speedups on SpecBench with 14B to 66B models.
- **AgentSpec (arXiv:2608.24004, Aug 2026):** This paper studies speculative decoding for batched inference in LLM agent workloads, using vLLM with EAGLE-3 and n-gram drafting.
- **Tutorial Proposal (arXiv:2503.00491, Mar 2025):** This is a tutorial paper that gives a general introduction to the technique.
- **A Survey on Efficient Inference for LLMs (arXiv:2404.14294):** This survey includes a section on speculative decoding, describing it as using a smaller draft model to predict tokens that the target model then validates.

The results are mostly from abstracts and snippets, so I haven't verified the reported speedups against the full papers.

2. **Speculative Decoding in Decentralized LLM Inference: Turning Communication Latency into Computation Throughput** (arXiv:2511.11733)
3. **Accelerating LLM Inference with Staged Speculative Decoding** (arXiv:2308.04623)
